records.jp: 工作……
records.en_original: Crafting...
records.en: Crafting...

records.jp: どうしたの、詩さん<CR>さっきから木の板をじっと見つめて
records.en_original: What's wrong, Uta? You've been staring at that wooden plank for a while now.
records.en: What's wrong, Uta? You've been staring at that wooden plank for a while now.

records.jp: ……少し考えていたんです。<CR>これで何か、みんなの役に立つものを作れないかと
records.en_original: I was just thinking... What can I make with this that would be useful for everyone?
records.en: I was just thinking... What can I make with this that would be useful for everyone?

records.jp: わあ、詩さんってば真面目さん！
records.en_original: Wow, you're so thoughtful, Uta!
records.en: Wow, you're so thoughtful, Uta!

records.jp: そうですか？<CR>真面目というのは、どのあたりが……？
records.en_original: Am I? What is that that you find thoughtful about me...?
records.en: Am I? What is that that you find thoughtful about me...?

records.jp: だって、何か役に立つものを<CR>作ろうとしてるんでしょ？
records.en_original: Well, you're trying to make something useful, aren't you?
records.en: Well, you're trying to make something useful, aren't you?

records.jp: 私だったら、好きなものとか<CR>楽しいものを作っちゃうなと思って！
records.en_original: If it were me, I'd just try to make something fun or something I liked!
records.en: If it were me, I'd just try to make something fun or something I liked!

records.jp: 好きなものや、楽しいもの……？<CR>今の私には、ちょっと難しいかもしれません
records.en_original: Something fun? Something I like...? That might be difficult for me at the moment.
records.en: Something fun? Something I like...? That might be difficult for me at the moment.

records.jp: そっかあ……
records.en_original: I see...
records.en: I see...

records.jp: じゃあ今は、『役に立つもの』を作りたいっていう<CR>詩さんの気持ちを大事にしてあげないとね
records.en_original: Then I guess for now I just have to respect your desire to make something useful.
records.en: Then I guess for now I just have to respect your desire to make something useful.

records.jp: 素敵なアイデアだね！<CR>『みんなの』ってところが、特に素敵！
records.en_original: That's a great idea! I like how you want to make something for everyone!
records.en: That's a great idea! I like how you want to make something for everyone!

records.jp: ……よかった
records.en_original: ...I'm glad.
records.en: ...I'm glad.

records.jp: 正直、的外れなんじゃないかと<CR>心配していたんですが……
records.en_original: To be honest, I was worried that I was missing the point...
records.en: To be honest, I was worried that I was missing the point...

records.jp: 星崎さんにそう言われると、自信が持てます
records.en_original: So it is reassuring to hear you say that, Ao.
records.en: So it is reassuring to hear you say that, Ao.

records.jp: うんうん！　めいっぱい自信持って？<CR>きっとみんなも喜んでくれるよ
records.en_original: Of course! Have some confidence! I'm sure everyone will love it.
records.en: Of course! Have some confidence! I'm sure everyone will love it.

records.jp: そういうことなら……
records.en_original: In that case...
records.en: In that case...

records.jp: よかったら、星崎さんから<CR>アドバイスをもらいたいです
records.en_original: Ao, would you mind giving me some advice?
records.en: Ao, would you mind giving me some advice?

records.jp: えっ、私？
records.en_original: Huh, me?
records.en: Huh, me?

records.jp: はい。星崎さんなら、<CR>この木の板を使って何を作りますか？
records.en_original: Yes. What would you make with this, Ao?
records.en: Yes. What would you make with this, Ao?

records.jp: ……まな板、とか？
records.en_original: A cutting board, maybe?
records.en: A cutting board, maybe?

records.jp: まな板……
records.en_original: A cutting board...
records.en: A cutting board...

records.jp: ほ、ほら……まな板って消耗品だし！<CR>たくさんあって困るものじゃないし！？
records.en_original: Y-yeah, think about it! Cutting boards get old and have to be replaced! You can never have too many!
records.en: Y-yeah, think about it! Cutting boards get old and have to be replaced! You can never have too many!

records.jp: どうして慌ててらっしゃるんですか？
records.en_original: Why have you suddenly become flustered?
records.en: Why have you suddenly become flustered?

records.jp: だって、詩さんが神妙な顔したから<CR>変なこと言っちゃったのかと思って……
records.en_original: When I saw the look on your face, I thought I might have said something dumb...
records.en: When I saw the look on your face, I thought I might have said something dumb...

records.jp: 星崎さん、変なことなんて言いましたっけ？
records.en_original: Did you say something dumb, Ao?
records.en: Did you say something dumb, Ao?

records.jp: むしろ、それを思いついた星崎さんに<CR>感心していたところです
records.en_original: I was actually rather impressed with your suggestion.
records.en: I was actually rather impressed with your suggestion.

records.jp: まな板なら、私みたいな初心者でも<CR>簡単に作れそうですしね
records.en_original: Even a beginner like me should be able to make something as simple as a cutting board.
records.en: Even a beginner like me should be able to make something as simple as a cutting board.

records.jp: スマホケースとか？
records.en_original: How about a phone case?
records.en: How about a phone case?

records.jp: えっ、木で作るんですか！？
records.en_original: Huh, do they make those out of wood?!
records.en: Huh, do they make those out of wood?!

records.jp: まあ、普通は布とかプラスチックだろうけど<CR>木でも作れないことないんじゃないかな
records.en_original: I mean, they're usually made of cloth or plastic, but who says you can't make one out of wood?
records.en: I mean, they're usually made of cloth or plastic, but who says you can't make one out of wood?

records.jp: 切り出す？　それとも、彫る……？<CR>難易度は高そうですね
records.en_original: Would I carve it...? It sounds quite difficult.
records.en: Would I carve it...? It sounds quite difficult.

records.jp: でも、みんなでお揃いのスマホケースとか<CR>テンション上がると思う！
records.en_original: But I'm sure everyone would be excited about having matching phone cases!
records.en: But I'm sure everyone would be excited about having matching phone cases!

records.jp: お揃いって、そんなにいいものですか？
records.en_original: Is it important to have matching things?
records.en: Is it important to have matching things?

records.jp: 人によるとは思うけど、私は嬉しいかな。<CR>『仲間』って感じがして
records.en_original: I guess it depends on the person, but it makes me feel happy. It's like proof that you're friends.
records.en: I guess it depends on the person, but it makes me feel happy. It's like proof that you're friends.

records.jp: 仲間って感じ……嬉しい……
records.en_original: Proof that you're friends... Makes you feel happy...
records.en: Proof that you're friends... Makes you feel happy...

records.jp: ……わかりました。<CR>それを作ってみます
records.en_original: Understood. I will try to make that.
records.en: Understood. I will try to make that.

records.jp: うん、頑張ろうね！
records.en_original: Yeah, let's give it our best shot!
records.en: Yeah, let's give it our best shot!

records.jp: え……手伝ってくださるんですか？
records.en_original: Huh...? Do you mean you will help me?
records.en: Huh...? Do you mean you will help me?

records.jp: もちろん手伝うよ！
records.en_original: Of course I'll help you!
records.en: Of course I'll help you!

records.jp: ありがとうございます。<CR>……あ、そうだ
records.en_original: Thank you very much. ...Oh, that's right.
records.en: Thank you very much. ...Oh, that's right.

records.jp: もうひとつ、お願いがあるんです
records.en_original: I have one more favor to ask of you.
records.en: I have one more favor to ask of you.

records.jp: お願い？
records.en_original: What favor?
records.en: What favor?

records.jp: 『みんなの役に立つもの』を作った後で、<CR>星崎さんのためのものも、作りたくて
records.en_original: After we make something useful for everyone, I want to make something for you, Ao.
records.en: After we make something useful for everyone, I want to make something for you, Ao.

records.jp: アドバイスを頂いたお礼……です<CR>受け取ってくれますか？
records.en_original: Something to thank you for your advice... Will you accept it?
records.en: Something to thank you for your advice... Will you accept it?

records.jp: ……っ！　詩さぁん！
records.en_original: *Gasp* Uta!
records.en: *Gasp* Uta!

records.en_original: Whoa...!
records.en: Whoa...!

records.jp: ありがとう！<CR>絶対ぜーったい受け取るよ！
records.en_original: Thank you! Of course I'll accept it!
records.en: Thank you! Of course I'll accept it!

records.jp: ……ふふ、よかった
records.en_original: ...Hehe, I am glad.
records.en: ...Hehe, I am glad.

records.jp: 私がいたら、邪魔になっちゃうかな？
records.en_original: Would I just get in your way?
records.en: Would I just get in your way?

records.jp: 邪魔……？<CR>私の邪魔をするつもりなんですか？
records.en_original: Get in my way...? Are you planning to get in my way?
records.en: Get in my way...? Are you planning to get in my way?

records.jp: 違う違う！<CR>私が、詩さんの足をひっぱったら悪いなあって
records.en_original: No, no! I just don't want to slow you down, that's all.
records.en: No, no! I just don't want to slow you down, that's all.

records.jp: そういうことなら、問題ありません
records.en_original: That will not be a problem.
records.en: That will not be a problem.

records.jp: 星崎さんがいてくださるなら、<CR>作るときにもアドバイスがもらえますから
records.en_original: If you don't mind staying, you can advise me as I work.
records.en: If you don't mind staying, you can advise me as I work.

records.jp: えへへ、そっか……！<CR>じゃあ、手伝わせてもらうね
records.en_original: Hehehe, I see! Then I'd be happy to help.
records.en: Hehehe, I see! Then I'd be happy to help.

records.jp: ふたりですごいの作って、<CR>みんなを驚かせちゃおう！
records.en_original: With the two of us working together, our craftsmanship will blow everyone away!
records.en: With the two of us working together, our craftsmanship will blow everyone away!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
